sh:sparql [ sh:message Literal("adjustedIceLoadForce must equal iceLoadForce multiplied by (1 - stringerOutsideIceBeltHeight / stringerSpan)") ; sh:select Literal("
                    PREFIX nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#>
                    PREFIX qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/>
                    PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

                    SELECT $this
                    WHERE {
                        $this nltl:iceLoadForce ?forceQuantity ;
                              nltl:stringerOutsideIceBeltHeight ?heightQuantity ;
                              nltl:stringerSpan ?spanQuantity ;
                              nltl:adjustedIceLoadForce ?adjustedQuantity .

                        ?forceQuantity qudt:numericValue ?force .
                        ?heightQuantity qudt:numericValue ?height .
                        ?spanQuantity qudt:numericValue ?span .
                        ?adjustedQuantity qudt:numericValue ?adjusted .

                        BIND (?force * (1 - (?height / ?span)) AS ?expected)
                        FILTER (
                            ABS(?adjusted - ?expected) >
                            IF(
                                ABS(?expected) > "0.001"^^xsd:decimal,
                                "0.000001"^^xsd:decimal * ABS(?expected),
                                "0.000001"^^xsd:decimal
                            )
                        )
                    }
                ") ] ] , [ sh:property [ sh:datatype xsd:boolean ; sh:hasValue Literal("false" = False, datatype=xsd:boolean) ; sh:maxCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:minCount Literal("1", datatype=xsd:integer) ; sh:path <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#supportedStringerOutsideIceBelt> ] ]
